subject: Final evaluation synthesis — board-ready readout slot request and contract trigger
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + next steps from discovery — NovaMed trial scope

Elena / Carlos — thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock in the trial scope and success criteria: 

Summary of needs (from call):
- Real-time routing of clinical notes into NovaMed EHR summaries (1–2s per note target latency)
- On-prem data residency for PHI, customer-managed keys
- Evaluation period: 6 weeks with ~2k notes processed/week (mix of short & long documents)
- Must pass security review (SOC2 + network diagram + NIL) before any on-prem install

Proposed POC plan (draft):
1) Week 0–1: Security docs exchange + network kickoff (Redwood + NovaMed infra lead)
2) Week 2–5: Trial ingestion + integration (dev owners: Redwood CS; NovaMed API owner)
3) Week 6: Final readout with execs — go/no-go decision and next steps for contract

Owners (prelim):
- Redwood CS: Marissa Cole (trial runbook, ingestion support)
- Redwood Security: Stephanie Nguyen (security artifacts, attestation)
- NovaMed: Carlos Ruiz (API access, test dataset owner)

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm the 6-week cadence and the target readout week of Dec 13–17?
- Please attach the minimal network diagram and SOC2 control evidence we can share with our Security team.

I attached a quick success-matrix and timeline for your review (see attached). I’ll follow up with a calendar hold for a readout once we get confirmation on the exec slot window.

Thanks —
Sean
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: novamed_poc_success_matrix.xlsx, novamed_trial_timeline_v2.pdf

From: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from discovery — NovaMed trial scope

Thanks, Sean — that matches what we heard on our side. Couple of clarifications and confirmations: 

- 6-week trial works for us; preferred readout week is Dec 13–17 (we can do Dec 14 morning for the exec window).
- We can provide SOC2 report and a light network diagram by EOD Friday (Dec 4).
- Success criteria we care most about (priority ordered):
  1) Accuracy of clinical note summarization vs. our clinician baseline (target: F1 >= 0.78 on our blinded set)
  2) End-to-end latency <= 2.5s median for notes < 2k tokens
  3) No PHI exfiltration — validated by our security tests

One ask: can Redwood provide a draft readout slide deck template and the specific data points you’ll surface at the executive readout? That will help our C-suite decide quickly.

—Elena
VP Product, NovaMed
elena@novamed.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Draft trial runbook, owners, and metrics to capture

Elena / team — I put together a minimally prescriptive runbook and added owners against each step. Highlights below, full runbook attached (novamed_trial_timeline_v2.pdf):

Runbook highlights:
- Week 0: Security artifacts exchange (owner: Stephanie) — deliverables: SOC2, network diagram, list of 3 test accounts
- Week 1–4: Integration + smoke tests (owner: Marissa) — deliverables: ingestion scripts, sample annotations, weekly health check
- Week 5: Blind evaluation run (owner: NovaMed / Carlos) — deliverable: blind test labels and evaluation script
- Week 6: Readout prep & exec deck (owners: Marissa + Sean)

Metrics we’ll capture (we’ll populate the success matrix spreadsheet):
- Summarization metric (F1) on blinded set — primary success metric
- Throughput & median latency (per note buckets) — perf gates with 95th pct
- Error modes & hallucination examples (qualitative)
- Operational readiness: deployment checklist pass/fail

Decision process for readout (proposal):
- Executive readout convenes: Redwood AE + CS, NovaMed CPO or Head of Clinical Ops, NovaMed CTO (or delegated)
- Readout outcome categories: Approve (proceed to contract signature), Iterate (another 4-week focused sprint), Stop
- Contract trigger: Approval will unlock an approved SOW + DocuSign link that Sean will send within 48 hours

I’ve attached the deck template and the updated timeline. Please review and confirm owners by EOD Monday so we can staff accordingly.

Thanks —
Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: novamed_trial_timeline_v2.pdf, novamed_poc_success_matrix.xlsx

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Readout deck + calendar hold for Dec 14 AM (PT) — please confirm

Elena / Carlos — following Marissa’s runbook, we pushed a readout deck draft into the shared Drive (link above) and added a tentative calendar hold for Dec 14, 09:00–09:45 PT for the executive sync. Before we lock the slot, two quick asks: 

1) Can NovaMed confirm attendee list for the exec slot? We recommend: CPO (decision owner), CTO (technical acceptance), Head of Procurement (contract questions)
2) Can you confirm acceptance thresholds for the F1 metric and latency bands so we can highlight pass/fail rows on the readout slide?

If we get confirmation today, I’ll finalize the DocuSign SOW and share within 24–48 hours post-approval. Also attaching Redwood’s SLA summary for the exec view.

Thanks —
Sean
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_sla_summary.pdf

From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@novamed.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Readout deck + calendar hold for Dec 14 AM (PT) — please confirm

Sean / team — confirming Dec 14, 09:00–09:45 PT for the executive readout. Attendees: Elena (CPO), Diego Alvarez (CTO, will attend), Sofia Martinez (Head of Procurement).

Acceptance thresholds confirmed:
- F1 >= 0.78 on blinded set = ACCEPT
- Median latency <= 2.5s for notes < 2k tokens = ACCEPT
- No critical security findings from our security test = ACCEPT

Assuming the readout meets the three accept conditions above, NovaMed’s procurement will be authorized to sign the SOW and procurement ticket immediately after the meeting. Please circulate the final deck 24 hours prior so our execs can review.

Carlos Ruiz
Director of Integrations, NovaMed
